title: The Claddagh Cottage | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Private Saltwater Pool (heating for an additional fee of $75/night)* 1.3 Miles to West Allen Loop Beach Access* 4 Included Bikes* 2.1 Miles to Shunk Gully, Growlers, and Gulf Place Town Center* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Private Saltwater Pool (heating for an additional fee of $75/night)* 1.3 Miles to West Allen Loop Beach Access* 4 Included Bikes* 2.1 Miles to Shunk Gully, Growlers, and Gulf Place Town Center* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Discover Your Perfect Getaway at The Claddagh CottageEscape to The Claddagh Cottage, a beautifully crafted 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat tucked away on a quiet street just north of 30A. Enjoy the tranquility of the location while staying just minutes from great dining options and local attractions.Inside, a fully equipped kitchen awaits your culinary creations, and the spacious master suite features a luxurious king bed and private ensuite. Another king bedroom and a third room with two full beds comfortably accommodate up to 8 guests. Spend your days lounging by your private backyard pool or take a bike ride to the beach with complimentary bicycles provided. Whether you're unwinding at home or out exploring, The Claddagh Cottage offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience to make your vacation unforgettable.Bed Setup:Master bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Full BedsAREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
